seo.title: Life at Maison Aster | Resident Experience & Events
seo.description: On-site management, 24/7 maintenance and a year-round resident calendar of rooftop dinners, run club, yoga and movie nights at Maison Aster in Toronto.

hero.title: Lifestyle
hero.subline: On-site service, a year-round calendar and neighbours you’ll actually know.

summary: Maison Aster is managed on site by Aster Living Group, with 24/7 maintenance and a year-round calendar of resident events.

philosophy.quote: “We know our neighbours by name here.”
philosophy.label: (Our approach)
philosophy.statement: Respond fast, fix things properly, treat every suite like our own. Then give people good reasons to meet.

items.heading: Dinners worth staying in for
items.body: Book the resident lounge’s chef’s kitchen and twelve-seat table, or join the monthly supper club on the roof.

items.heading: Wellness on the calendar
items.body: Morning yoga twice a week, a run club on the ravine loop, and a fitness studio that never closes.

items.heading: Pets welcome, properly
items.body: Up to two pets per suite, a dog wash on the ground floor and a park at the end of the street.

slider.heading: Life at Maison Aster
slider.body: A few moments from the resident calendar.

cta.heading: A home, well kept. Come see it for yourself.
